blocking_gates.reason: Occurrence-only reasoning fails for semantic equality and extensionality unless repaired by semantic support or cover accounting.

ordered_strategy: Resolve or sharply advance the formula-semantic extraction fork for one concrete proof-system fragment.
Audit the enriched draft theorem chain as a dependency graph with hypotheses, proof dependencies, non-claims, and barrier status.
Emit a live P vs NP inference-quality packet for the actual theorem candidate.
Close the prior-art and novelty boundary against hardness magnification, MCSP/MKtP, natural proofs, relativization, algebrization, and proof-complexity routes.
Repair the paper narrative around scoped contribution, not global separation.

forbidden_outputs: paper promotion without live inference-quality packet
claims about P != NP or SAT notin P/poly

continue_if: The branch fixes a concrete source object, target object, proof system, and lower-bound sentence.
The branch proves or refutes an extraction map, semantic support object, witness-cover object, or transfer inequality.
The branch emits or directly prepares a live inference-quality packet.
backtrack_if: The branch treats occurrence-label reasoning as full SAT semantics.
The branch hides advice, nonuniformity, or valid-length restrictions.
The branch repeats the open fork without choosing a proof-system fragment.
pivot_if: A concrete fragment fails by a minimal countermodel.
Prior art subsumes the exact theorem statement.
A named SAT-semantic rule escapes row-support accounting and becomes a stronger contribution.

required_repairs: formula-semantic boundary theorem or honest open-boundary framing
